timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Welcome to the board tour of the all new Beaglebone Black from BeagleBord.org.
This new Beaglebone features some serious upgrades that make it better, stronger, and faster
than the original.
These upgrades include Texas Instruments, one gigahertz CETARA AM-335X, ARM, Cortex A8 CPU,
two gigabytes of onboard EMMC storage, 512 megabytes DDO.
VR3 RAM, and an all new micro HDMI slot for connecting a TV or monitor.
The board also comes standard with a host of other features, as well as software that helps
you start developing in seconds.
At just $45, this credit card size computer is the most affordable entry into our growing
community of developers innovating with open hardware.
For detailed information about the Black and for ideas to help you get started, check out
BeagleBord.org today.
What will you create?
Let's take a quick look at your first experience with the all new Beaglebone Black from BeagleBord.org.
Once connected with a provided USB cable, your computer will recognize the board as a flash drive.
An included HTML file will guide you through the installation of any drivers needed to enable
USB functionality.
The board then opens your browser to a website that hosts an interactive tutorial for learning
more about the hardware and provided software.
This includes the Cloud9 IDE for developing physically interactive software in JavaScript,
as well as an introduction to accessing other provided compilers and interpreters like
Python.
Get started at BeagleBord.org today.
What will you create?
